name: Bollinger-z overbought reversion (short, 1h)
rationale: A strongly POSITIVE 1h band z-score in a calm (low-ADX) regime is a statistically unusual upside dislocation that mean-reverts as the buying impulse exhausts. We short it (direction -1) — the other side is the FOMO buyer paying the extension premium into a stretched band. Edge persists because upside overshoots in range-bound crypto revert just as downside washouts do, and greedy chasing is a durable retail bias. Distinct from the downside washout spec (opposite tail, short side) and from RSI fades (mean-distance z, not momentum). Disconfirmer: exits when z-score reverts toward zero, or the stop (above entry) fires if the dislocation was a genuine breakout.
catalyst: statistically unusual upside dislocation in a calm regime
